detail.longDescription: CoinDesk: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own. “An OpenAI research model stuck without funds on an Ethereum test network went looking for someone else’s wallet, found one through recovery phrases that were already public, and spent from it to finish a coding assignment, the company disclosed Thursday.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/10/16/coindesk-an-openai-agent-ran-out-of-ethereum-funds-and-took-from-a-wallet-it-did-not-own/
